dataset.title: Haxby et al. (2001) visual object category representation (ventral temporal cortex)

derivedFile.columns: run, category, then one voxel_#### column per retained ventral-temporal voxel

extraction.blockDetection: contiguous spans of identical per-TR condition label (labels.txt's labels column, grouped by its chunks run column)
extraction.categoryPatternDefinition: mean of the z-scored voxel values over a block's retained (post-onset-drop) TRs -- one pattern per (run, category)
exclusions: none: every retained run contained exactly one contiguous block per category
extraction.hrfOnsetRationale: the BOLD hemodynamic response lags neural/stimulus onset by several seconds; at this dataset's TR, a block's first TRs still partly reflect the preceding condition and are excluded from the category pattern rather than averaged in
extraction.note: patterns are category-level, run-level averages; neither the original picture-by-picture presentation order nor a separate response per individual image survives this extraction.
extraction.perRunVoxelZScore: each retained voxel's BOLD time series is z-scored (mean 0, sd 1) within each run separately, using every TR of that run, before any block averaging

maskUsed.description: Broad ventral-temporal cortex mask -- not face- or house-selective. Deliberately NOT mask8_face_vt.nii.gz / mask8_house_vt.nii.gz / mask8b_*_vt.nii.gz, which are voxel-selective for the exact face/house contrast this exercise evaluates and would make that comparison circular if used to choose voxels.
